Implement the Verilog module based on the following description. Assume that signals are positive clock/clk edge triggered unless otherwise stated.

Correct the syntax error in the code.

Reply with the complete corrected module in a ```verilog code block.

Problem Description:
Implement in Verilog the following circuit: A two-input XNOR (connected to 'in1' and 'in2) has an output connected to the input of a two-input XOR. The second input of the XOR is 'in3.' The output of the XOR is 'out'.

module top_module (
	input in1,
	input in2,
	input in3,
	output logic out
);

Erroneous Implementation:

always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
	out <= ~(in1 ^ in2) ^ in3;
end

endmodule

Feedback:
